text_block_list.text:
After our outing, 
I went to look at clothes with 
Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There are many clothes here that suit my 
tastes. 
I find this shop quite useful.

Phalaenopsis picked out outfits without a 
trace of hesitation. 
A faux-leather jacket. Animal-print 
accessories. 
Gold jewelry...
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, Phalaeno, your tastes 
are...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, Phalaeno-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, fancy meeting you again! ♪ 
What's up, here to check out the new 
arrivals? 
Finally down to try a cropped top?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She already said no 'cause she has to 
regulate her body temp. 
You really don't know when to quit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, but she'd look so good in it! 
Seriously, it'd look amazing!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... 
I do intend to give it a try when the 
timing is right.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sweet, yaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We often cross paths in this shop. 
Since then, she has been tutoring me in 
the art of dressing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It was so unexpected that I just had to 
say hi. 
Like, 'A shop like this, not a kimono 
store?!' 
But we kept bumping into each other, and 
she was agonizing over it so seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's super fun helping her pick stuff out, 
and it looks great on her. 
I'm so glad we became friends.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she has treated me with great 
kindness. 
Thanks to her, I have learned what styles 
flatter me. 
I cannot thank her enough.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stop! No need for all that! 
After all, we're—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bazaars, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, shopping spree complete! ♪ 
I'm so glad you found some accessories you 
liked.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
Thanks to you, I've taken another step 
closer to becoming a gyaru.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, why do you like gyaru fashion so 
much? 
You'd look so good in neat, elegant 
clothes, too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That is... 
a matter of personal taste, one might say.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Personal taste!? 
Wait, you're into the gyaru aesthetic!?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Well, perhaps rather than mere taste—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I hold reverence for them—for 'gyarus'.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? Huh, for gyarus?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What I revere is their spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A gyaru never compromises. 
She pursues every possible discipline for 
the sake of her appearance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And she never falters. 
She proudly holds aloft her own splendor.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well duh, if you go all out on your look, 
you've gotta hype yourself up or it's no 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Precisely that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To hone oneself without compromise, 
to falter before no one, and to proudly 
hold one's brilliance high.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That is none other than—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Basara.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ba-Basara!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I had a feeling you'd ask that...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Basara refers to warriors unbound by 
convention, 
who proudly uphold their brilliance and 
martial might.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Staking their lives on battle, scattering 
sparks, 
and blooming in full splendor—ah, their 
sheer beauty.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A flower blooming on the battlefield 
cannot survive 
through grace alone.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Like them, I wished to adorn myself. 
Brilliantly, yet fiercely. I wished to don 
both.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The ones who fulfill that wish in the 
modern era 
are 'gyarus'.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: In other words, gyarus are basara.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Then again, when I do my glam, I'm 
totally in a 'nobody beats me' mood. 
Wait... is this what being basara is?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, 'war paint' is a phrase for a 
reason... 
Haha, I guess so. Makes you want to stand 
taller when doing your makeup.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why! 
Wait, so it wasn't 'bazaar', it was 
'basara' all along!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
From this day forth, with the deepest 
respect, 
I shall continue to don gyaru attire.
choice_data_list: The way of the gyaru runs deep...
Flashy outfits suit you well, too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
There is much to learn from it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You, too, should find one. 
Attire worthy of reflecting your true 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And then—wear it with pride.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Listen to you, talking big.
